action.thought_summary: Use documented apply dispatch and returned state; couple initial apply/outbox/commit as one repair block.

proposals.mechanism: Repairs unsupported methods and stale state; an applied-but-uncommitted restart can still skip durability steps.
proposals.predicted_outcome: May pass the clean path; restart after direct application or outbox staging is uncertain because durability is inside the not-applied guard.

action.thought_summary: Reconstruct application, outbox, durability, delivery and cleanup as separate obligations.

proposals.mechanism: Durability continues while not committed even when applied is already true; acknowledgement and lease cleanup are independent terminal obligations.
proposals.predicted_outcome: Expected to pass complete source recovery; transaction rollback is reconstructed from fresh public state without suppressing crashes.
